items.title: Bucks Announce Coaching Staff For 2026/27 Season
items.content:
The Bucks announced in a press release on Friday that new head coach Taylor Jenkins has finalized his coaching staff for the 2026/27 season.

Here are the staff members who will each have the title of assistant coach:

Darvin Ham
Pat St. Andrews
Vince Legarza
Brad Jones
Johnny Carpenter
T.J. Ford
Schuyler Rimmer

Ham is the most noteworthy name of the group and the lone holdover from last season’s staff. The former NBA forward and longtime assistant was head coach of the Lakers for two years (2022-2024) before rejoining the Bucks in the 2024 offseason. He’s entering his third consecutive season as a Milwaukee assistant and seventh overall.

St. Andrews spent the 2025/26 campaign with Portland after a two-year stint as an assistant in Memphis under Jenkins. He spent five years as an assistant with the Bucks (2018-23) and got his NBA start with Atlanta.

Further details on the remaining coaches — including former Bucks point guard Ford, who’s entering his first season as an NBA assistant — can be found in the team’s announcement.

In addition to the full-fledged assistants listed above, Jenkins will also have three other staff members. Jack Herum, who’s entering his eighth season in Milwaukee, will return in an assistant coach/player development role, while Isaiah Wilkins and Nshan Kenjoian have been named assistant coach/player development and head video coordinator, respectively.
